title: Can marital rape exception shield husbands for injuries or deaths of wives? Supreme Court to examine
description: The Supreme Court recently issued notice to Central government on a petition seeking a declaration that the marital rape exception does not bar prosecution where forceful, non-consensual sexual acts by a husband result in bodily injuries or death to his wife. [Red Dot Foundation v.
